# Pandamonium v1.0.79

Pandamonium 1.0.79 brings the CT103-proven Entertainment, SSH, feedback, marketplace, and native Linux work into the signed public release. PandaFlix 1.2.2 is the public movie/show runtime, language controls prefer English audio and expose subtitles, and the release removes the newly disclosed MCP dependency advisory while preserving updater rollback.

## MAD-856 — Feedback: add guided in-app bug reports with redacted evidence

### Problem

The report flow could expose every panel at once and asked for redundant reproduction text.

### Implementation

The wizard now shows one step at a time, removes the redundant field, and keeps reviewed redacted evidence.

### Product value and UI visibility

Operators get a clear report flow with screenshots, diagnostics, and a usable review step.

### Verification

Playwright bug-report coverage and focused feedback Python tests passed in the merged suite.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

No stored report schema is removed; `validate_steps` remains accepted for compatibility.

### References

- [Linear MAD-856](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-856)
- [GitHub evidence](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/commit/a52e507f51764ef3d8954ae41a238ef7a581940d)

## MAD-940 — Plugins UI: show installed and configured plugins with capability detail

### Problem

Installed packages dominated the marketplace and web-surface plugins were labeled as broken.

### Implementation

Not-installed cards sort first, installed cards carry a badge, and web surfaces report available readiness.

### Product value and UI visibility

Operators can find packages they can add and understand installed browser integrations at a glance.

### Verification

Marketplace Playwright coverage and extension-plugin-view Python coverage passed.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

This changes presentation and ordering only; package identity and lifecycle contracts are unchanged.

### References

## MAD-972 — Entertainment: integrate AniCLI and PandaFlix end to end

### Problem

AniCLI movie control labels appeared as episodes and the short anime sting was cut off.

### Implementation

Control labels are filtered, single-entry movies play directly, selected titles remain visible, and the full supplied sting is used.

### Product value and UI visibility

Anime browsing now distinguishes movies from episodic titles and keeps the intended presentation.

### Verification

Merged Entertainment Playwright coverage exercises direct movie play, control filtering, and playback.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

The adapter remains backward compatible with packages that do not report an explicit kind.

### References

- [Linear MAD-972](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-972)
- [GitHub evidence](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/commit/279a890e314e7b3e9500b8ff003f399d31101d30)

## MAD-976 — Settings: SSH connections tailnet scan and one-click add of tailnet nodes

### Problem

Tailnet nodes required manual address/key handling and Tailscale check-mode guidance was not actionable.

### Implementation

Settings can discover opaque tailnet peers, add managed keys with a one-time password, or use Tailscale SSH with a clickable approval link.

### Product value and UI visibility

Operators can connect nodes without exposing tailnet addresses to agents or manually moving key files.

### Verification

Focused SSH discovery/key-install Python tests and browser coverage passed.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

An additive `auth_mode` column defaults existing rows to `managed_key`; password material is never written to argv, disk, audit, or payloads.

### References

- [Linear MAD-976](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-976)
- [GitHub evidence](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/commit/7f1a15df7e82c895713faf3fd8082d3ef37d6f70)

### Problem

The bug-report entry was cramped, hidden by a collapsed section, or absent from the main navigation.

## MAD-986 — Web: persist and restore the active view and open tool windows across reload

### Problem

A reload discarded the focused full-screen surface and open docked tools.

### Implementation

A bounded client view-state module restores supported surfaces and tool windows, with unknown ids falling back to chat.

### Product value and UI visibility

Operators return to the workspace they were using instead of reconstructing it after every reload.

### Verification

Dedicated view-restore Playwright coverage passed with the merged modal lifecycle.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

The view key stays in local storage and never changes session URL or server data.

### References

- [Linear MAD-986](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-986)
- [GitHub evidence](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/commit/5c8f508f4433b4915a9adbfed31a1f253b13a92c)

## MAD-989 — Feedback: submit reviewed reports to the n8n relay (no per-install GitHub App)

### Problem

Public installations could not submit reviewed feedback without per-install GitHub credentials.

### Implementation

The server sends the reviewed allowlisted payload to the configured operator relay with idempotency and schema headers.

### Product value and UI visibility

Installations gain a credential-free operator feedback path while security reports remain excluded.

### Verification

Focused relay and feedback tests passed, including the flattened diagnostic allowlist.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

`PANDAMONIUM_FEEDBACK_RELAY_URL` is optional; the existing GitHub App path remains the fallback.

### References

- [Linear MAD-989](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-989)
- [GitHub evidence](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/commit/1168949137f7718ad9ba6d4465c54211a7957537)

## MAD-1010 — Plugins: detect and auto-provision host system requirements on install (interactive sudo), and mark Docker incompatibilities

### Problem

### Verification

System-requirement, installer, marketplace, and sandbox tests passed.

## MAD-1012 — Entertainment: PandaFlix movies/shows fail in the web player (resolve 500 + extensionless HLS)

### Problem

Sandbox-local subtitle paths and extensionless playlist URLs caused web playback failures.

### Implementation

Non-public subtitle paths are dropped safely and extensionless playlist endpoints are classified as HLS.

### Product value and UI visibility

Movies and shows now resolve in the web client instead of failing with a plain-text 500.

### Verification

Focused route coverage plus live CT103 movie resolve and HLS HTTP 200 proof passed.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Only public subtitle URLs reach the browser; SSRF-safe media proxy boundaries remain enforced.

### References

- [Linear MAD-1012](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-1012)
- [GitHub evidence](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/commit/63968fcd136052888a05a95362076db94660ba08)

## MAD-1013 — Entertainment: add back navigation through results, seasons, and episodes

### Problem

Drilling into a title trapped the user in seasons or episodes without a reliable way back.

### Implementation

A bounded results stack restores results, seasons, and episodes, and Browse returns to the originating list.

### Verification

## MAD-1014 — Entertainment: add a Continue Watching library tab with next-episode queueing

### Problem

Progress history created duplicate show rows and completed shows could remain because an older episode was unfinished.

### Implementation

Continue Watching groups by show, uses the furthest episode, queues the next episode, supports removal, and repairs stale covers.

### Product value and UI visibility

Resume behavior now reflects the next useful action rather than raw history recency.

### Verification

Four Continue Watching browser scenarios passed, including completion and stale-cover fallbacks.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Preference changes are additive; existing history entries continue to normalize.

### References

- [Linear MAD-1014](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-1014)
- [GitHub evidence](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/commit/f732a775a8c5bf55936a3e98e4cff41fac3cb987)

## MAD-1023 — Entertainment: PandaFlix TV playback buffers (starts at 1080p and buffers the whole episode)

### Problem

Multi-bitrate streams started at the largest level and looked stuck while fetching too much data.

### Implementation

The player starts on the smallest level, releases the cap after eight seconds, and keeps bounded forward/back buffers.

### Product value and UI visibility

TV playback reaches the first frame quickly while adaptive quality can still ramp up.

### Verification

Playwright verifies level selection, buffer values, cap release, and timer cleanup.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

HLS-only behavior changes; direct file playback is unaffected.

### References

- [Linear MAD-1023](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-1023)
- [GitHub evidence](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/commit/b0913cb5e30906828ab2acfacb0fcd0af6f3928d)

## MAD-1024 — Entertainment: "Resolving stream…" bubble never clears after playback starts

### Problem

The resolving status remained over an already playing stream.

### Implementation

The active video element clears the status on its `playing` event while an idle preloader cannot clear it.

### Product value and UI visibility

The player no longer looks stuck after playback begins.

### Verification

Browser coverage verifies both active and inactive slot behavior.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

This is client-only status behavior and changes no playback API.

### References

- [Linear MAD-1024](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-1024)
- [GitHub evidence](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/commit/96c7fe52615c1e2bcb63af82b46dc6d124c32f15)

## MAD-1025 — Entertainment: retry transient provider resolves instead of failing Continue Watching

### Problem

A temporary provider/network failure dead-ended playback and non-JSON errors could surface as parse failures.

### Implementation

Resolve calls retry bounded 5xx/network failures, stop on client errors, and normalize malformed error bodies.

### Product value and UI visibility

Continue Watching and fresh playback recover from brief provider instability without unbounded retries.

### Verification

Python and Playwright coverage passed for 5xx, text, network, exhaustion, and non-retryable 4xx cases.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Retries remain capped at three and preserve server-provided detail when available.

### References

- [Linear MAD-1025](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-1025)
- [GitHub evidence](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/commit/c38914dc03b57f3dfe89982bbad1a0bb887a883d)

## MAD-1026 — Native Linux: install Pandamonium with user setup and working Entertainment

### Problem

The public source lacked a reproducible non-container laptop install and robust native upgrade recovery.

### Implementation

A pinned native Linux installer now validates host admission, database readiness, user-service startup, backups, rollback, and media behavior.

### Product value and UI visibility

Users can install the same application profile proven on the EndeavourOS/Arch laptop without downloading local models.

### Verification

Native installer, embeddings, sandbox, Entertainment, and setup-wizard coverage passed; PR #312 was reconciled into this release.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

The profile is Linux-specific, keeps data outside the source tree, and leaves Docker/macOS/Windows flows unchanged.

### References

- [Linear MAD-1026](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-1026)
- [GitHub evidence](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/312)

## MAD-1029 — Marketplace: publish the repaired PandaFlix DNS and fallback runtime

### Problem

The signed catalog still pointed at the old PandaFlix source, so reinstalling could restore the DNS/provider failure.

### Implementation

The recipe now pins merged source `e69971a` and publishes signed PandaFlix 1.2.2 with immutable digest verification.

### Product value and UI visibility

Every clean install and upgrade now receives the repaired search/fallback runtime instead of a local override.

### Verification

Upstream Go tests, package validation, signed clean install, normal CT103 upgrade, near-match search, resolve, HLS, and subtitle proof passed.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Signing trust is unchanged; PandaFlix 1.2.1 remains retained as the package rollback revision.

### References

- [Linear MAD-1029](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-1029)
- [GitHub evidence](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/314)

## MAD-1036 — Entertainment: bring audio and subtitle language controls to CT103

### Problem

A valid stream could start in Italian and offered no reliable subtitle-language control.

### Implementation

The player exposes Audio and Subtitles menus, prefers English when present, persists each language separately, supports Off, and keeps controls in fullscreen/preload transitions.

### Product value and UI visibility

Users hear the intended track and can select readable subtitles without reopening the stream.

### Verification

Merged Playwright coverage passed for English preference, unavailable languages, native/external tracks, fullscreen, and reordered preload tracks.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Streams without reported tracks keep source audio and show honest availability; Anime sub/dub preference remains separate.

### References

- [Linear MAD-1036](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-1036)
- [GitHub evidence](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/commit/b36e37519e7682e9243ef2eaa2dfb335f129bdc4)

## MAD-1037 — Release: publish Pandamonium 1.0.79 with CT103-proven fixes

### Problem

The public application remained on 1.0.78 while verified laptop and CT103 work lived on overlapping branches, and `mcp` 1.28.1 gained CVE-2026-59951.

### Implementation

The release reconciles current main, PR #312, and the CT103 overlay, bumps all version/cache surfaces, and updates `mcp` to compatible fixed 1.30.0.

### Product value and UI visibility

The public package now matches the proven deployments and no longer carries the known MCP advisory.

### Verification

Integration proof includes 38 Entertainment/Marketplace browser tests, 14 setup tests, 182 focused platform tests, 304 MCP tests, and three dedicated-runtime lifecycle tests before full CI and live upgrade gates.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Rollback keeps v1.0.78, the pre-update CT103 snapshot, and PandaFlix 1.2.1; no branch protection or security check is bypassed.

### References

- [Linear MAD-1037](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-1037)
- [GitHub evidence](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/commit/33ebf74f22c8b98f5b5bec2f04829bcc6f74779b)
